en-US.title: Tally Stick: Split Bills
en-US.subtitle: Shared expenses & IOU tracker
en-US.promoText: Split bills with friends and housemates, see exactly who owes whom, and record settlements however you pay.
en-US.description:
Dinner with friends, rent with housemates, a weekend away. Tally Stick keeps one clear record of who paid and who owes, so nobody has to work it out from memory.

SPLIT BILLS YOUR WAY
• Split a bill equally, or enter an exact amount for each person
• One person can pay or several, and the payers don’t have to be the people sharing the cost
• Every split adds up to the total, with nothing lost to rounding

GROUPS AND FRIENDS
• Start a group for a home, a trip or a regular dinner and keep its shared expenses in one place
• Keep a separate one-to-one ledger with a friend for the everyday “I’ll get this” moments
• Groups have no admins. Everyone who joins has the same say

SEE WHO OWES WHOM
• Each ledger shows one exact balance per person
• Balances come from the recorded expenses and settlements, and every edit keeps its history
• Send a balance reminder to someone who owes you

SETTLE UP HOWEVER YOU PAY
• Pay in cash, by bank transfer, or any way you already use
• Record the settlement and everyone’s balance updates
• Tally Stick is a record. It never holds, sends or converts money

A PRIVATE EXPENSE TRACKER TOO
• Record your own income and expenses in a personal ledger only you can see
• Reports show your spending by category and can include your share of shared expenses
• You add every entry yourself, with no bank account to link

CLEAR FROM THE START
• Notifications when an expense, settlement or invitation involves you
• Choose your currency symbol: PKR, USD, GBP, EUR, AED or SAR. Amounts are never converted
• Export your records, review signed-in devices, or delete your account from the app
• Light and dark appearance

For ages 16 and over.
